goals.title: Scoped natural-language helper everywhere
goals.scope: Public site, Operations, parent portal, student portal, provider workspace, One Time/Rabbi workspace, and Family App/Home Accountability.
goals.definition_of_done: Each surface has one visible helper named for that scope; helper responses and tools are permission-scoped; actions use confirmation gates; missing integrations create blockers instead of fake success.
open_decisions: Which high-risk tools can become live after approval
pending_external_actions: Approval for any high-risk live tool action

goals.title: Long ramble intake to decisions, pending, and Codex work
goals.scope: Telegram, Codex attachments, Downloads prompt files, repo memory, Operations task lanes, agent lifecycle, and prompt intake.
goals.definition_of_done: Raw rambles are captured, distilled, deduped, mapped to decisions, pending access items, Codex work, blocker records, proof files, and terminal statuses.
open_decisions: Automatic Downloads watcher versus explicit audit command

goals.title: Natural-language assignment and accountability
goals.scope: BNA students, parents, admins, One Time Mishnayos participants, goal boards, worksheets, questions, checkoffs, and reports.
goals.definition_of_done: Parent/admin natural-language notes become scoped accountability records; students receive assignments/goals; progress, questions, worksheets, participation, and reports remain privacy-scoped.
pending_external_actions: Approved parent credential/session path for additional parent visual proof

goals.title: Provider integration onboarding and secret storage
goals.scope: Provider-owned Resend, Buffer, WAPI/WhatsApp, Vimeo, Zoom, Stripe, GoDaddy/DNS, Google Drive, and future connector accounts.
goals.definition_of_done: Provider/workspace-scoped integration rows, secret refs, redacted audit logs, setup UI, helper tools, readiness tests, and approval gates exist; raw secrets are never returned or logged.
open_decisions: Compatibility aliases for bna_workspace_integrations/bna_secret_refs naming versus current provider-scoped model
pending_external_actions: Explicit approvals for real provider actions

goals.title: Service provider index and free basic landing pages
goals.scope: Public provider directory, provider join flow, free basic provider pages, provider workspace, provider-specific leads and integrations.
goals.definition_of_done: Providers can get a reviewed free basic listing/page from uploaded media/info; provider workspace and integrations remain scoped; custom domains stay optional/future.

goals.title: One Time Mishnayos product, funnels, class, and library
goals.scope: Rabbi Scheller / One Time provider workspace, public draft funnels, 7pm Israel class calendar, product tiers, interest leads, member/library workflow, source prep.
goals.definition_of_done: Product system is decision-ready, draft/noindex funnels exist, class calendar and library workflow are first-party, live checkout and access grants happen only after explicit decisions and smoke proof.

goals.title: Product-grade UI cleanup
goals.scope: Public site, Operations, super admin, service provider workspace, parent portal, student portal, Family App/Home Accountability, One Time, integration setup, decisions/pending/tasks/detail modals.
goals.definition_of_done: One brand system and predictable navigation per surface; mobile-first; no duplicate helper buttons, unreadable panels/cards, random duplicate actions, or horizontal overflow at 375px.
open_decisions: Which additional UI surfaces need visual proof before launch

goals.title: Legacy Family Accountability cleanup while preserving Family App
goals.scope: README, setup docs, archived family-app docs/code, active BNA runtime, Family App/Home Accountability workspace.
goals.definition_of_done: Repo identity is BNA v2.0; archived family-accountability material is historical; any active Family App/Home Accountability product is explicitly scoped as one workspace/product, not the whole repo.
open_decisions: Whether Family App/Home Accountability is a retained product line and what its first live scope should be
pending_external_actions: Shloimie product decision if family workspace should become active
proof_required: Smoke proving BNA/public/Operations identity remains current

goals.title: Ramble watchdog and goal-led work until done
goals.scope: Long rambles, prompt packets, Downloads files, Codex attachments, Telegram captures, Operations status, prompt register, agent ledger, changelog, tasks-pending handoffs, and live-proof requirements.
goals.definition_of_done: Each ramble/prompt source is captured, deduped, mapped to durable goals, decisions, pending blockers, Codex work, proof requirements, and terminal statuses; watchdog audits catch stale starts, duplicate work, prompt-without-proof gaps, local-only work marked done, UI drift, helper architecture gaps, secret risks, and unresolved Thursday blockers.
open_decisions: Explicit command versus automatic Downloads/attachments watcher
Safe auto-fix authority for docs, queue cleanup, and UI/code fixes
When staged watchdog helper tool names become live helper actions
pending_external_actions: Thursday access/account-owner decisions for Zoom, GoDaddy/DNS, Vimeo, Resend, Buffer, WAPI/WhatsApp, Stripe, and old One Time app preservation
proof_required: Direct authenticated allowedViews readback includes watchdog
